ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of the fraud schemes in Minnesota and the involvement of state officials
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the investigation
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and hold those in power accountable. By following the money and tracking the investigation, we can uncover the truth and bring transparency to the situation.
